title: Critique a user flow
prompt:
[Insert screenshot] + Review this user flow with a product designer lens.

1. Restate the job-to-be-done in one sentence.
2. Call out friction points that add cognitive load, dead ends, or trust risk.
3. Suggest 3 concrete improvements ranked by impact vs. effort.
4. Note any accessibility or mobile constraints I should not ignore.

Keep feedback specific to the screens and copy shown — avoid generic advice.

title: Finding a component
prompt: [Insert screenshot] + Point me to this component in this repo
